keyPoints: Nirdeshank akshon (x-aksh kshitij, y-aksh urdhva) ke katav bindu ko mool bindu (0,0) kehte hain — yahin se naap shuru hoti hai.
Bindu (x, y) me pehle x phir y likhte hain — (3, 2) ka matlab x-aksh par 3 chal kar y disha me 2 utho.
Rekhik aalekh (linear graph) seedhi rekha hota hai — y = 2x me x badhne par y dugna badhta hai, isliye rekha seedhi hai.
Aalekh se do rashiyon ka sambandh turant dikhta hai — samay-doori aalekh me dheemi chaal ka dheemaa jhukaav hota hai.
Dand-aalekh (bar) tulna ke liye aur rekh-aalekh (line) samay ke saath badlaav dikhane ke liye behtar hota hai.
Samay-doori aalekh me seedhi rekha samaan gati dikhati hai; ruki hui gadi ka aalekh seedhi kshitij rekha hota hai — doori badhti hi nahi.
Aam galti: x aur y nirdeshank ulta likhna — (2, 5) aur (5, 2) alag-alag bindu hain, kram zaroori hai.
subject: Maths
title: Aalekhon ka Parichay
